source.metadata_notes:
Viet Nam administrative level 0-1 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 02.  
  
This dataset is structured into 1 level:  
- Admin 1: 34 Province  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 25 September 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 25 September 2025: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 25 September 2025: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 01 July 2025: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific (ROAP)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-roap).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)

processing_history: Verify SHA-256 of downloaded HDX ZIP.
Read vnm_admin1.geojson and select exactly one adm1_pcode=VN01 feature.
Preserve original properties, coordinates, rings and vertex order; no simplification, buffering or geometry repair.
Serialize a UTF-8 FeatureCollection with indent=2 and a trailing LF.
temporal_policy: Use the fixed 2025 Hanoi ADM1 footprint as the common analysis domain for all dates 2021-2025; not a claim of year-specific historical legal boundaries.
selection_rationale: Direct GSO-origin COD-AB release reviewed by OCHA, with identifiable version, open attribution license and detailed original geometry. Preferred to the traced 2008 Wikipedia-derived gbOpen file. The archived 2020 Government/HDX gbHumanitarian release was compared as a historical alternative.
limitations: Research analysis boundary, not a cadastral survey or legal demarcation certificate.
Area computed in EPSG:3405 is not expected to equal the source area_sqkm attribute exactly.

superseded_boundary.verification: Selected VN-HN feature geometry equals the previous project geometry.
